name: bandit-fort
description: The Bandit Fort (story/bandit_fort, _2, _3; ROADMAP 49): three whole levels from one recipe (LEVEL=1..3). MC_BUILDER = the minecraft-builder skill's folder. 'build' writes candidates.

scripts.build: for l in 1 2 3; do LEVEL=$l node "$MC_BUILDER/scripts/run-build.mjs" recipe.mjs --out-dir out --data-version 3955 || exit 1; done && python3 ../../rebuild.py bandit_fort story/bandit_fort --nbt out/bandit-fort.nbt --candidate && python3 ../../rebuild.py bandit_fort story/bandit_fort_2 --nbt out/bandit-fort-2.nbt --candidate && python3 ../../rebuild.py bandit_fort story/bandit_fort_3 --nbt out/bandit-fort-3.nbt --candidate
